items.issue: Two historical 022c end masses use rounded joint coefficients.
items.evidence: SUPPLEMENT.json lists owner and unrounded values, exact coefficients and assembly impact.
items.resolution_needed: Use 1550/(2π·1470e6·28.9e6) and 4430/(2π·827e6·28.9e6) in the next regeneration, or label the coefficient precision.

items.issue: Campaign and Be stock costs are projections without specimen-specific supplier evidence.
items.evidence: Cost sums reproduce. Official UW/UNR rates are partial service anchors and do not establish Be acceptance or turnkey costs.
items.resolution_needed: Before an authorized purchase, define quantities, fixtures, hours, process/yield, material cost, analysis and facility scope; retain quotes separately from assumptions.

items.issue: The shared-stock example assumes a 24×72 inch blank at about 0.8 mm.
items.evidence: Materion assigns reduced dimensions to 0.020–0.058 inch sheet. The mass arithmetic is right, but that full-envelope product is not established.
items.resolution_needed: Obtain a finished-gauge/blank/process specification and a cutting layout; revise the stock/process allowance if only smaller or thicker blanks are available.

items.issue: A P2 CSV heading describes fixed other modes but its values are conditional minima.
items.evidence: The gamma=0.2 row contains 0.354507, while the other modes stay at one. METHOD describes the correct min(affected,1) operation.

items.issue: F1249-20 is cited although ASTM identifies F1249-25 as active.
items.evidence: The official F1249-20 version list and the retrieved F1249-25 page confirm the edition difference. No procedural difference is asserted.
items.resolution_needed: Select and record the executing lab's controlled edition. Preserve C365 as compression/modulus evidence; it does not characterize compressive core crush.

items.issue: Coupon, surrogate and axial-joint successes do not supply full installed-hull SF.
items.evidence: The owner already distinguishes biaxial transfer, yield-censored wrinkles, component size, contacts and unknown joint restraint.
items.resolution_needed: Retain those conditions in purchase acceptance tables and subsequent model updates; use effective capacities only for the tested mode and state.

items.issue: Minimum radii use hypothetical 25 µm/1 mm floors and a partly matched Al/core system.
items.evidence: 0.361403286198 m and 0.430344116083 m reproduce. Custom core, foil compression, forming and defect-field transfer remain unverified.
items.resolution_needed: Demonstrate actual gauges/properties and the as-built dimensionless state before procurement. Keep the current dent ratio an imposed experiment parameter.

items.issue: The quoted 034 leakage and trapped-gas examples have older geometry inventories.
items.evidence: Current 028b seam length is 2841.518544 m versus 808.893916 m in 034 P2. Current 022d joints/plies also change the bill.
items.resolution_needed: Re-inventory final seams, adhesives, cells, bores and barriers, then evaluate initial/species gas, hot pressure and added mass separately; retain the 100 kg systems line.
